description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminQueue web page in an Online Examination System. It manages session validation, database queries related to course queues, and navigation between pages based on user actions.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminQueue ASP.NET page, handling page events, session validation, database operations related to course queue management, and navigation controls.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load, validating session variables, querying the database to check if a course queue is empty, and potentially deleting related entries from another queue.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the AdminPanel page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Reloads or refreshes the current AdminQueue page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by navigating to the LoginPage.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles user selection in a GridView, storing selected row data into session variables, and navigating to the ShowAns page.
